titles.text: Randomized, Embedded, Multifactorial Adaptive Platform trial for Community-Acquired Pneumonia

objectives.name: CORE 6.1
objectives.text: The primary objective of this Platform is, for hospitalized patients with acute respiratory tract infection, to evaluate the effect of a range of interventions on a composite of 90-day all-cause mortality and, among survivors, a daily ordinal scale of trajectory of illness and recovery to 28 days.

endpoints.name: CORE 7.6.1
endpoints.text: The primary endpoint, named Survival and Recovery Trajectory, will be a composite of 90-day all-cause mortality and, among survivors, a daily ordinal scale analyzed as a trajectory of illness and recovery to 28 days.

objectives.name: CORE 6.2
objectives.text: The secondary objectives of this Platform are to determine the effect of interventions on hospital length of stay (LOS) and 90-day mortality, as well as other domain-specific endpoints and, where feasible or specified in a DSA or RSA, survival, health related quality of life (HRQoL), and disability assessed after 180 days.

objectives.name: CS_DSA 7
objectives.text: The objective of this domain is to determine the effectiveness of different strategies of corticosteroid utilization for hospitalized patients with severe lower-respiratory tract infection.

endpoints.name: CS_DSA 8.5.1
endpoints.text: The primary endpoint, named Survival and Recovery Trajectory, will be a composite of 90-day all-cause mortality and, among survivors, a daily ordinal scale analyzed as a trajectory of illness and recovery to 28 days.

endpoints.name: CS_DSA 8.5.2
endpoints.text: serious adverse events (SAE) as defined in the Core Protocol

arms.name: No corticosteroid (no placebo)
arms.dataOriginDescription: Patients will be randomly assigned to receive one of the following open-label study interventions.

arms.name: Shock-dependent hydrocortisone while the patient is in septic shock (Severe State only)
arms.dataOriginDescription: Patients will be randomly assigned to receive one of the following open-label study interventions.

arms.name: Fixed duration dexamethasone for 10 days

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: CORE 7.4.1 #1
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Hospitalized patient

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: CORE 7.4.1 #2
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Acute respiratory tract infection

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: CORE 7.4.1 #3
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Aged 28 days or older

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: CORE 7.4.2 #1
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Death is deemed to be imminent and inevitable during the next 24 hours AND one or more of the patient, substitute decision maker or attending physician are not committed to full active treatment.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: CORE 7.4.2 #2
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Patient is expected to be discharged from hospital within the next 24 hours

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: CORE 7.4.2 #3
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Previous enrollment in this Platform within the last 90 days

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: CS_DSA 8.2.1 #1
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Patient is aged ≥ 28 days old (corrected gestational age)

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: CS_DSA 8.2.1 #2
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Patient has lower-respiratory tract infection

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: CS_DSA 8.2.1 #3
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: If in the Severe State, patient has pneumonia

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: CS_DSA 8.2.1 #4
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: If in the Moderate State, patient is receiving some form of supplemental oxygen (simple facemask, low or high flow nasal oxygen, or non-invasive ventilation)

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: CS_DSA 8.2.2 #1
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: CS_DSA 8.2.2 #2
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Hospital-acquired respiratory tract infection, except where the patient has confirmed influenza infection

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: CS_DSA 8.2.2 #3
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Known hypersensitivity to any corticosteroid

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: CS_DSA 8.2.2 #4
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Intention to prescribe systemic corticosteroids for a reason that is unrelated to the current respiratory tract infection, such as chronic corticosteroid use before admission, acute severe asthma, or suspected or proven Pneumocystis jiroveci or COVID-19 pneumonia

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: CS_DSA 8.2.2 #5
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: If in the Severe State, more than 24 hours have elapsed since commencement of sustained organ failure support

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: CS_DSA 8.2.2 #6
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: The treating clinician believes that participation in the domain would not be in the best interests of the patient

titles.text: Randomized, Embedded, Multifactorial Adaptive Platform trial for Community-Acquired Pneumonia

objectives.name: CORE 6.1
objectives.text: The primary objective of this Platform is, for hospitalized patients with acute respiratory tract infection, to evaluate the effect of a range of interventions on an ordinal scale that is a composite of 90-day all-cause mortality; among survivors, the number of days for which the patient did not receive organ failure support during the index hospitalization until the end of study day 28; and, among survivors who never receive OFS, hospital free days for the index hospitalization up to the end of study day 28.

endpoints.name: CORE 7.6.1
endpoints.text: The primary endpoint is a composite of 90-day all-cause mortality and, among survivors, the number of days on which the patient was not receiving organ failure support (OFS) during the index hospitalization, up to the end of study day 28; and among survivors who never receive OFS, hospital free days for the index hospitalization up to the end of study day 28.

objectives.name: CORE 6.2
objectives.text: The secondary objectives of this Platform are to determine the effect of interventions on hospital length of stay (LOS) and 90-day mortality, as well as all components of the primary endpoint, other domain-specific endpoints, platform-wide exploratory endpoints and, where feasible or specified in a DSA or RSA, survival, health related quality of life (HRQoL), and disability assessed after 180 days.

endpoints.name: CORE_41 7.6.2 #2
endpoints.text: Days alive and free of organ-failure support to day 28

endpoints.name: CORE_41 7.6.2 #3
endpoints.text: Days alive and out of hospital to day 28

objectives.name: CS_DSA 7
objectives.text: The objective of this domain is to determine the effectiveness of different strategies of corticosteroid utilization for hospitalized patients with severe lower-respiratory tract infection.

endpoints.name: CS_DSA 8.5.1
endpoints.text: The primary endpoint is a composite of 90-day all-cause mortality and, among survivors, the number of days on which the patient was not receiving organ failure support (OFS) during the index hospitalization, up to the end of study day 28; and among survivors who never receive OFS, hospital free days for the index hospitalization up to the end of study day 28.

endpoints.name: CORE 7.6.1 (V4.0) additionally reported
endpoints.text: The primary endpoint, named Survival and Recovery Trajectory, will be a composite of 90-day all-cause mortality and, among survivors, a daily ordinal scale analyzed as a trajectory of illness and recovery to 28 days.

endpoints.name: CS_DSA 8.5.2
endpoints.text: serious adverse events (SAE) as defined in the Core Protocol

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: CORE 7.4.1 #1
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Hospitalized patient

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: CORE 7.4.1 #2
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Acute respiratory tract infection

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: CORE 7.4.1 #3
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Aged 28 days or older

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: CORE 7.4.2 #1
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Death is deemed to be imminent and inevitable during the next 24 hours AND one or more of the patient, substitute decision maker or attending physician are not committed to full active treatment.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: CORE 7.4.2 #2
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Patient is expected to be discharged from hospital within the next 24 hours

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: CORE 7.4.2 #3
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Previous enrollment in this Platform within the last 90 days

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: CS_DSA 8.2.1 #1
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Patient is aged ≥ 28 days old (corrected gestational age)

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: CS_DSA 8.2.1 #2
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Patient has lower-respiratory tract infection

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: CS_DSA 8.2.1 #3
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: If in the Severe State, patient has pneumonia

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: CS_DSA 8.2.1 #4
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: If in the Moderate State, patient is receiving some form of supplemental oxygen (simple facemask, low or high flow nasal oxygen, or non-invasive ventilation)

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: CS_DSA 8.2.2 #1
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: CS_DSA 8.2.2 #2
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Hospital-acquired respiratory tract infection, except where the patient has confirmed influenza infection

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: CS_DSA 8.2.2 #3
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Known hypersensitivity to any corticosteroid

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: CS_DSA 8.2.2 #4
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Intention to prescribe systemic corticosteroids for a reason that is unrelated to the current respiratory tract infection, such as chronic corticosteroid use before admission, acute severe asthma, or suspected or proven Pneumocystis jiroveci or COVID-19 pneumonia

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: CS_DSA 8.2.2 #5
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: If in the Severe State, more than 24 hours have elapsed since commencement of sustained organ failure support

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: CS_DSA 8.2.2 #6
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: The treating clinician believes that participation in the domain would not be in the best interests of the patient
